title: adaptor.json
body:
{
  "id": "zstandard",
  "version": "schemaxis.zstandard/1",
  "adaptor": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.adaptor",
  "declarations": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.adaptor:DECLARATIONS",
  "capabilities": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.capabilities:catalogue",
  "runtimeFamily": "1.5.7",
  "execution": "Durable file compression and restore, Zstandard dictionaries, delta references, checked frames and profile comparisons",
  "executables": ["zstd"],
  "keywords": ["Zstandard", "zstd", "lossless compression", "dictionary training", "compressed scientific data", "delta snapshot", "gzip xz lzma lz4"],
  "display": {"name": "Zstandard", "mark": "Zs", "colour": "#376b59"},
  "executionCapabilities": {"modes": ["process"], "mpi": false},
  "consoleTemplate": {"version": "schemaxis.zstandard/1", "operation": "compress", "source": "/replace/with/data.bin"},
  "consoleCapabilities": {"authoredSessions": true, "multipleDocuments": true, "liveGeometry": false, "nativeEditReverseSync": false},
  "cliOptions": [{"flag":"--zstandard","dest":"zstandard","help":"Trusted Zstandard 1.5.7 zstd executable for compression and fresh verification"}],
  "routes": {
    "schemaxis.zstandard/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.adaptor",
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.adaptor:schema",
      "graphEditing": false,
      "workflow": true,
      "compose": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "schemaName": "zstandard",
      "acceptedArtifacts": ["file", "text"],
      "hooks": {
        "query": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.adaptor:query",
        "resources": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.adaptor:resources",
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.adaptor:reusableInputs",
        "acceptResource": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.captured_inputs:accept_resource",
        "capturedInputSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.zstandard.captured_inputs:captured_schema"
      }
    }
  }
}
